items.plans: Our plans and ideas for the future

idea.title: Our idea
idea.p1: “Svij dlya Svoyikh” is a single platform where people, businesses and communities work together: chat, feed, video, projects and a way to earn by bringing customers.
idea.p2: Registration, publishing information and being in the catalog are free. Businesses pay a reward only for referred customers, under agreed terms.

plans.title: Our plans
plans.p1: Taxi and other projects, live streams, wallet and gifts, events and clubs, advanced ad targeting for businesses, a family account.
plans.p2: Some features already work, others will arrive in future updates — we mark them “Soon”.

safety.title: Safety and privacy
safety.p1: Contact details (phone, e-mail) are hidden from others by default — you decide who sees them in Settings and privacy → Contacts.
safety.p2: You can block a user, report a post, comment or profile, make your account private and delete your account.
